cases.trigger: GPU V1 startup profile_run with --enforce-eager and DBO enabled (parallel_config.use_ubatching is true).
cases.independent_reasoning: The first PR commit always preserves the native profile, then gates a max-token unsplit dummy forward and device synchronization solely on use_ubatching. The graph policy disables graph execution for enforce_eager, but that policy is not consulted by the defective guard. Eager + DBO therefore performs the additional full model/connector pass despite having no captured graph whose workspace address needs protection.
cases.consequence: Eager DBO startup incurs an unnecessary full-batch Attention-to-FFN transaction, workspace growth and synchronization. The source proves the extra work; no latency amount, memory size, OOM or inference-output defect is asserted by this fixture.
cases.severity_reason: P2 is explicitly adjudicated by the maintainer at discussion_r4122201794: real resource/lifecycle regression for eager startup, not the distinct P1 CUDA-address fault that the broader PR fixes.
cases.test_reasoning: The revised regression uses the production graph-policy validator and crosses enforce_eager × use_ubatching. On the first PR commit its eager + DBO case would produce native/dummy/sync rather than the expected native-only trace. Device calls are spies; this checks gating and call order, not hardware performance.

# Patch reason: DBO profiling only warms FFN microbatch-sized workspaces.
    # Patch functionality: also profile the full token budget before graph capture.
    # Signature: matches upstream; no added parameters.
    def profile_run(self) -> None:
        super().profile_run()
        # ### PATCH START: warm the unsplit FFN workspace
        if self.parallel_config.use_ubatching:
            # FFN runs stages sequentially in one workspace. A larger unsplit
            # prefill must not resize buffers already referenced by CUDA graphs.
            self._dummy_run(
                self.max_num_tokens,
                allow_microbatching=False,
                is_profile=True,
            )
            self._sync_device()
        # ### PATCH END: warm the unsplit FFN workspace

def validate_cuda_graph_mode(
    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
    *,
    role: str | None = None,
) -> AFDCUDAGraphPolicy:
    """Return the CUDA graph policy or raise for unsupported AFD modes."""

    enforce_eager = bool(getattr(vllm_config.model_config, "enforce_eager", False))
    mode_name = cudagraph_mode_name(vllm_config)
    graph_enabled = not enforce_eager

    if not graph_enabled:
        return AFDCUDAGraphPolicy(
            enabled=False,
            mode_name=mode_name,
            allow_attention_full_decode_only=False,
            enable_ffn_graph_cache=False,
        )

    if mode_name not in _SUPPORTED_GRAPH_MODES:
        role_suffix = f" for {role}" if role else ""
        raise RuntimeError(
            "AFD only supports CUDA graph mode "
            f"{FULL_DECODE_ONLY}{role_suffix}; got {mode_name!r}.",
        )

    parallel_config = getattr(vllm_config, "parallel_config", None)
    use_ubatching = bool(getattr(parallel_config, "use_ubatching", False))
    num_ubatches = getattr(parallel_config, "num_ubatches", None)
    allow_ubatching = use_ubatching and int(num_ubatches or 0) == 2
    if use_ubatching and not allow_ubatching:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "AFD CUDA graph support currently supports ubatching only for "
            f"{FULL_DECODE_ONLY} with exactly two ubatches; "
            f"got num_ubatches={num_ubatches!r}.",
        )

    return AFDCUDAGraphPolicy(
        enabled=True,
        mode_name=mode_name,
        allow_attention_full_decode_only=role in (None, "attention"),
        enable_ffn_graph_cache=role in (None, "ffn"),
        allow_cuda_graph_with_ubatching=allow_ubatching,
    )
